events.strDescriptionEN:
Real Madrid hosted Real Sociedad at the Estadio Santiago Bernabéu on Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 LaLiga season.

The primary hurdle for the home side was establishing control over a disciplined Real Sociedad setup that threatened on fast breakaways. The main objective for Real Madrid centered on using rapid vertical passing and clinical finishing from their attacking front to dismantle the visitor's defensive shape. Concurrently, the mission for Real Sociedad involved sitting compact, frustrating Madrid's midfield orchestration, and striking effectively through transition opportunities.
